_comment: Runs of the conformance suite (spec/IR_SPEC.md section 11.4): one results file per engine, with every case's verdict and detail. SKIP means the engine has no path for the case (the reference: the gradient cases, which are its own finite differences; mtstudio: single ops other than expr and recurrence, sessions, document loading, refusals, dequantisation; ember: single ops other than recurrence, whose run_node its adapter has, and the gradient cases, since it does not train). The numpy and mtstudio runs are of revision 1.1 as first released (274 cases); ember's is of keramos v1.1.1 (284 cases).

runs.engine: numpy reference, tools/ir_numpy.py (numpy 2.3.3, WSL Python 3.12.3), spec revision 1.1

paperkiln mtstudio CPU, with ir_eval for recurrence nodes, their gradients and the digest, at spec revision 1.1 (ext4 build of HEAD 20898f37 plus revision 1.1; vendored transformer_core, Release, GCC 13.3, -ffp-contract=off)

ember.cpp ir_adapter, CPU interpreter, ember 39dcce94886fbac759c26c123007d7e106b84aed (/home/jonat/ember_adapter_39dcce9/build/ir_adapter (git archive of that commit, CPU only: HAS_CUDA off, Release, GCC 13.3, WSL ext4; the interpreter's IR translation units with -ffp-contract=off); hello: 'ir_adapter 2 (IR versions 0 and 1; spec revision 1.1)'), against keramos v1.1.1 (6170ee052cf20d65687428a25288843148646c1e)
